svg.title: The line was a lie. It was always a graph.
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “The line was a lie. It was always a graph.” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A hand-drawn diagram in two halves. Above, a clean straight chain of triage, fetch logs, diagnose and report is struck through as what we wished it was. Below, the same work is redrawn as a graph with START and END nodes, a severity decision that routes P1 to a human, P2 and P3 to fetch logs and spam to END, and an 'enough evidence?' decision whose no branch is a real curved back-edge to fetch logs carrying a highlighted counter reading attempts 2 of max 3. A typed state card lists ticket_id, severity, log_excerpts as an appending list with reducer circled, attempts and hypothesis, with dashed lines to every node.
svg.text: The line was a lie. It was always a graph.
draw it from memory, then compare
